findings.actual_failure: Every grant written from the shown template is refused malformed with detail key:confirmed_at; the grant path never yields a working grant, and the content test only checks key names.
findings.observation: The grant template in author-delivery-brief SKILL.md quotes confirmed_at and expires_at, so they parse as TOML strings, not offset date-times.

findings.actual_failure: In an adopter repo a change editing .claude/skills/work-loop/references/brief-runner.md or the work-loop scripts reports guard_surface empty, hiding that the grant-enforcing code changed.
findings.observation: guard_surface hard-codes this repository's packs/core/.apm source paths, so an installed copy in an adopter repository never lists its own guidance or scripts.
findings.rule_ref: AC-0028 guard_surface; packs/AGENTS.md portable pack content

findings.actual_failure: A checkout whose config has a filter name -c cannot empty makes guard print a fifth refusal code that CI consumers keyed on the four codes misread.
findings.observation: guard calls the hardened git helper, whose filter read re-raises denied-git-config, a refusal code AC-0028 does not list.

findings.actual_failure: A controller reading the table mislabels grant states to the human; handling stays the same.
findings.observation: references/brief-runner.md describes grant null as no grant file, says anchor and limits appear whenever a grant parsed, lists expired under grant-refused, and says grant-spent means done_when met only.

findings.actual_failure: In a depth-limited checkout a grant edited alone (later expiry or an added slice) and a brief edited after confirmation both read valid, breaking bound-to-what-was-shown; the shallow test only monkeypatches a log failure.
findings.observation: In a shallow clone git log -1 --first-parent returns the shallow-boundary commit, so the anchor becomes the base, the brief compares with itself, and the unreadable first parent is read as absent so the not-reconfirmed check is skipped.
findings.reachable_path: brief-runner.py _binding, tree_entry and read_blob returning None on Git failure

findings.actual_failure: A test-file change in a mixed pull request can shadow python3 or rewrite Git state so the guard prints pass for a grant change mixed with code.
findings.observation: The guard step runs late in gate-main after steps that execute the pull request's own code, which can alter PATH, GITHUB_ENV or the Git state the guard reads; the wiring guidance does not require the guard to run before the change's code.
findings.reachable_path: .github/workflows/build-check.yml gate-main guard step; references/brief-runner.md wiring steps
findings.rule_ref: AC-0019 guard not weakened by the change it judges
